note: BLOCKED: the style is made of real printed matter (STYLE.md §1: "every figure is a cut-out of a real public-domain print (an engraving, a stamp, a news photo, a line drawing)… Nothing is drawn in a vector or 3D way to look printed"; §9: "only public domain and CC0 prints, each one in the credits"). The library ships no scans (the demo downloads them in `build.sh` from Wikimedia Commons, listed in `SOURCES.jsonl`), and this environment's network refuses the archive hosts: `upload.wikimedia.org`, `commons.wikimedia.org`, `www.loc.gov` and `archive.org` all answer `403 Forbidden (agent proxy: no rule or network setting allows this host)` (checked 2026-11-27). Drawing fake engravings in code would break the style's first rule; it is not substituted with a generic version.
short: Made of real public-domain prints; the archive hosts are refused by this network.
